story_info.title: Barnaby Bunny and the Gentle Wind
story_info.subtitle: A calming story for sleepytime.

main_character.name: Barnaby Bunny
main_character.appearance: Barnaby is a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose. He has a plush, huggable, storybook-soft look.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D children's book illustration of Barnaby Bunny, a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose, sitting peacefully in Moonlight Meadow at sunset. A gentle breeze blows past him, making a few soft petals float. Warm cinematic lighting, pastel colors, vertical composition, Instagram friendly.

slides.title: Evening in Moonlight Meadow
slides.text: Barnaby Bunny was in Moonlight Meadow. The sun was going down. A soft, cool breeze began to blow. Barnaby watched the tall grass dance. He wiggled his little pink nose. He felt a tiny bit restless inside. It was almost time for bed.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby is feeling restless as evening comes.

slides.title: The Wind's Soft Song
slides.text: The gentle wind whispered around him. Whoosh, whoosh, went the air. Barnaby liked the wind’s calm sound. He looked up at a big, soft fluffy cloud. It floated slowly across the sky. He watched it move far away. He felt a little more calm inside.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby listens to the wind and watches a cloud.

slides.title: A Cozy Breathing Spot
slides.text: Barnaby found a very cozy spot. It was under a big, old flower. The wind felt extra gentle there. He closed his round sleepy eyes. He took a big, deep breath in. Then he let a slow breath out. 'Like the soft wind,' he thought.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby tries deep breathing with the wind.

slides.title: Floating Like a Leaf
slides.text: He breathed in slowly again. He breathed out slowly. Whoosh, whoosh, in and out. His whole body felt calm and light. He imagined he was a little leaf. A leaf gently floating down. Floating down to his very soft bed.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby practices his breathing, imagining he's a floating leaf.

slides.title: Sweet Dreams Begin
slides.text: Barnaby smiled a little sleepy smile. He felt very sleepy now. The gentle wind helped him relax. He hopped slowly back to his warm home. He was ready for sweet, happy dreams. Sweet dreams begin with a smile!
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby is now calm and ready for sleep, thanks to the wind.
